name: JD Meyers
headline: Photo, video and drone operator who builds web tools and automation.
summary: I run a photography, videography and FAA Part 107 drone business in the North Country of New York, and I build the dashboards, pipelines and contracts that keep it running. This page lists the skills I can back with real work.

skills.name: Wedding photography and videography
skills.summary: Full-day coverage with tiered photo and video packages, multi-camera video and a defined delivery process.

evidence.title: 2026 wedding season
evidence.note: Paid coverage across the season, from preparation through delivery and review requests.

skills.name: Portrait, graduation and real estate photography
skills.summary: Seniors, graduations, families and real estate, plus a studio headshot service launched in October 2026.

evidence.title: Studio headshots
evidence.note: New service line with its own equipment kit, light and dark backgrounds, and a signup system.

skills.name: Video and audio post-production
skills.summary: Final Cut Pro editing, highlight and full-ceremony edits, and licensed-music scoring.

evidence.title: Multi-camera editing
evidence.note: Edit plans for three-angle stage productions starting in 2019, and delivered client films in 2026.

evidence.title: Audio
evidence.note: Logic Pro project work and licensed music for client video. This is the thinnest part of the skill.

skills.name: Commercial drone operations
skills.summary: FAA Part 107 remote pilot work: aerial photo and video, airspace authorization, flight logging and risk assessment.

evidence.title: Flight discipline
evidence.note: Maintained flight logs, a LAANC and flight-planning workflow, and a standardized pre-flight risk assessment template.

evidence.title: Subcontract work
evidence.note: Operator work for drone service networks in 2025 and 2026.

skills.name: Front-end web development

evidence.title: Monthly recap dashboard

evidence.title: Recap builder
evidence.note: A web app that lets other people generate their own recap dashboard (March 2026).

skills.name: Python scripting and data pipelines
skills.summary: Scripts that pull from APIs, parse databases, match records and render reports.

evidence.title: Pipelines
evidence.note: Social API pulls, payment-to-ad conversion matching, workout database parsing and HTML email rendering.

skills.name: Scheduled monitoring and digest systems
skills.summary: Recurring digests and alerts that compare against a baseline and only report changes.

evidence.title: Daily and weekly digests
evidence.note: Business, market and local-area summaries delivered by email on a fixed schedule.

skills.name: Git and GitHub Pages deployment

evidence.title: Static sites

skills.name: Workflow and tracker apps

evidence.title: Office tool set

skills.name: Test-prep web app

evidence.title: AFOQT app

evidence.title: jdmeyersjr.com

evidence.title: Template set
